_meta.description: Held-out Vietnamese industrial sentences for measuring glossary term recovery.
_meta.rationale: The T4 glossary A/B built its probe set out of the glossary itself, so growing the table from 61 to 93 terms could not move the sentence-level number: find_terms over the 12 fixed sentences returned the identical 34 terms under both tables. A coverage measurement whose probes come from the thing being measured cannot detect coverage. These sentences are written independently and deliberately exercise terms across the whole table, including ones added after the first measurement.
_meta.usage: exp_t4_bidirectional.py experiment D. Report recovery over these, not over bare glossary entries - a bare entry is an exact whole-utterance hit and never reaches the decoder.
_meta.caveat: Authored for this project, not drawn from a real factory transcript corpus. They are plausible industrial Vietnamese, not attested Vietnamese. A real held-out set from recorded shop-floor speech would be strictly better and does not exist yet.
